g.text: Reusable semantics become enterprise-specific instances — follow the four ontology tiers.
DESIGN v0.2 / Existing data, new presentation. No live execution or customer evidence is implied.
Schema: L1–L3 · World State instances: L4 · This view does not depict the Laws layer.
Reusable concepts · public identifiers + Silex anchors
PLANE SIZE = LAYOUT ONLY / RIBBON WIDTH = CROSS-TIER RELATION COUNT
Counts are from the bundle. Cross-tier links include Silex-authored mappings.
Select a tier → inspect its composition → open the same tier in Security Ontology.
Public IDs retain their source links.
